name: Maul (subzone)
summary: In Maul, fighters face beasts and rivals in the sunken pit beyond Dire Maul. The Broken Commons ring once belonged to Eldre'Thalas, but no faction now keeps order on its floor.

sections.title: The Sunken Pit
sections.body: Deep in the Broken Commons, Maul’s stone pit once hosted the Highborne of Eldre'Thalas for theater or ceremony. After the Sundering, Gordok ogres took the ruins, and the pit became a raw colosseum. Like the Gurubashi Arena in distant Stranglethorn Vale, its sands erase allegiance. Fighters from opposing factions meet freely, and survival belongs to the strong.

sections.title: Beasts and Bloodshed
sections.body: Take care on the way down. Daring fighters sometimes leap from the Broken Commons’ high ledges, but the fall hits hard. A western archway leads down more safely through tunnels where Gordok hyenas sleep. It is the only way out on foot. Dangerous beasts and notorious gladiators enter at irregular times, so each descent brings an uncertain fight.

faq.q: Why can I attack members of my own faction here?
faq.answer: Maul is a lawless fighting pit, much like the Gurubashi Arena in Stranglethorn Vale. Faction treaties and truces do not hold on its sands, and combatants may fight anyone outside their party.

faq.q: How do I safely enter and leave the Maul?
aliases: how to get into the maul
faq.answer: A leap from the Broken Commons can cause serious falling damage. Take the safer way through the western doorway and past sleeping Gordok hyenas. It is also the only route back out on foot.

faq.q: What kinds of enemies appear in the arena?
faq.answer: Rival adventurers meet dangerous beasts and gladiators in the pit. Among them are the fungal giant Mushgog, the chimera The Razza, and Skarr the Unbreakable.

faq.q: What was this arena originally used for?
faq.answer: Before the Sundering, the stone colosseum belonged to the Highborne city of Eldre'Thalas. The Gordok ogres later turned the ancient elven structure into a blood arena.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can test your strength in Maul outside organized battlegrounds. Personal prowess and thick armor decide who survives.
As a Night Elf, you see ancient Eldre'Thalas’s proud architecture reduced to an ogre-infested execution pit. It recalls the fall of Highborne civilization.
